description: chain_walk allocates an 8 KiB stack buffer to re-encode TBSCertificate for signature verification. Certs with TBS > 8 KiB return Error::Der with an error message from the der crate that does not mention the stack buffer limit. The implementation limit is documented in the Error::Der variant doc, but not in the validate_path function doc. A no_std embedded developer who hits this will see a mysterious DER encoding error on a cert that OpenSSL validates successfully. The Error::Der doc says 'An implementation limit, not a certificate defect' which is good, but users who match on Error::Der to detect malformed certs will also catch this case.
title: 8 KiB TBS limit not documented in validate_path signature
